source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 26 - Replacement Washer for Brake Filter.pdf
title: Replacement Washers for Brake Machine Filters
lead: To meet the continuing needs of our customers the MOC Machine and Equipment Department now has available replacement washers for the filters (Part Nos. 98030 and 98026) used on the Brake Machines. These washers are available in a pack of 5 (Part No. 98769).
body: (This picture is of 1 washer only. This Part No. is for a pack of 5.)
